name: Edison Plaza (1971, Toledo Edison HQ, now ProMedica/KeyBank), 300 Madison Ave
refs: refs/w580662591/00 (Edison Plaza, Madison Avenue and Summit Street, Toledo, OH, Wikimedia Commons)
notes: Late-modern office tower: reflective blue-grey glass curtain wall on a tight mullion grid, framed at each end by tall blank limestone-clad service cores that rise above the roofline, dark band at the crown; low glass-and-stone podium/garage.
